Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error by incorrectly identifying the skin as the organ consisting mostly of nerve tissue. While the skin is rich in nerve endings for sensation, it is primarily composed of epithelial tissue (epidermis) and connective tissue (dermis). The brain, however, is the organ that consists mostly of nerve tissue (neurons and glial cells). The Planner failed to apply basic biological knowledge to distinguish between "densely innervated" (skin) and "composed mostly of" (brain), leading to an incorrect final answer.
